policy: RESIDENTIAL DWELLING INSURANCE / Policy wording "WD-2026" - Water Escape, External Surfaces and Site Charges
description: Buildings frost claim after a cold snap. An internal water fitting burst in the freeze and was repaired, with a thermal camera used to locate the escape first. Separately, exterior plaster cracked and fell off the facade under the outdoor cold. It has been kept simple, with each trade billing a single combined line.

lines.1: Internal frost-burst fitting repair including thermal- imaging leak detection | 1 flat rate
lines.2: Exterior facade frost damage repair (re-plaster and repaint) | 1 flat rate
